dialogue_text: Take off that gown, Tolani.
Take off that gown, Tolani. You are not graduating today. You are going home with your husband. Uncle Jide, what husband? They told us the best
Uncle Jide, what husband? They told us the best students walk in first. Look at me. I am your late father's brother.
Look at me. I am your late father's brother. I have fed you for seven years, and today you pay me back. This man works for the company I owe.
This man works for the company I owe. From today, you belong to his house, and my file stays quiet. Uncle, they call my name in one hour. Let me hold my certificate first,
Uncle, they call my name in one hour. Let me hold my certificate first, then shout at me at home. Forget your certificate. A certificate has never paid one naira of my debt.
Forget your certificate. A certificate has never paid one naira of my debt. Papa said nobody can repossess what you learned. Your papa is not the one those lenders are calling.
Take it off. A gown does not wash plates.
Sir, please. She is the best in our set. Let her walk first. Then let her walk to the car.
Let her walk first. Then let her walk to the car. Nobody drags her, sir. She walks.
Your things, we packed them this morning
Your things, we packed them this morning before you even ironed that gown this morning until you sat at breakfast and prayed over my results. And God answered you are finished with
over my results. And God answered you are finished with school. From today you tell your people that my file is quiet. Your file will wait, sir.
file is quiet. Your file will wait, sir. You heard all of it, so let me say it plainly. My uncle is my late father's
You heard all of it, so let me say it plainly. My uncle is my late father's younger brother. He raised me for seven years and he just gave me a way on the road beside my own
He raised me for seven years and he just gave me a way on the road beside my own graduation. Nobody can give you a way. You are not one of his cars. Then what am I standing here for?
You are not one of his cars. Then what am I standing here for? Wait here. I have one errand inside the hall. When I come back, you choose where you go. Not me and not him.
go. Not me and not him.
Sir, they have called you twice. The Vice Chancellor is sweating. Then straighten my tie quickly. Please rise for our guest of honor,
Then straighten my tie quickly. Please rise for our guest of honor, an old student of this faculty, Ademola. And now the Ademola prize for the best
And now the Ademola prize for the best graduating student in accounting, Tolani Bakare.
Vice Chancellor, she was here at 8:00. This year she wrote auditing with a fever and she still came first. She is not absent, sir. She was taken
She is not absent, sir. She was taken out of that line before you called her. Give her certificate and her prize to me. I will put them in her hand myself.
Give her certificate and her prize to me. I will put them in her hand myself. Sir, her uncle phoned the registry yesterday. He asked us to release her certificate to him, not to her.
yesterday. He asked us to release her certificate to him, not to her. And did you? Not while I hold the keys to that registry, sir.
Sir, the man who owes us 60 million naira just gave you his niece.
Sir, the man who owes us 60 million naira just gave you his niece. And he was in a hurry. Men in a hurry are hiding something.
You did not run. Run where? He changed the locks this morning. I have 4,000 naira and a gown I

Take this for a hotel tonight. Only tonight. No. I will not eat a dead food. Whatever my uncle owes your company, I will pay it with my own hands.
my uncle owes your company, I will pay it with my own hands. You owe nothing. Then why did you take me?
Because if I said no, he would have offered you to the next man with a file. Did they call my name?
Did they call my name? They called it. And nobody stood up. The woman I work for has a guest room
The woman I work for has a guest room and her cook left last week. Work for your bed if you like.
Work I can do. Seven years of work I have already done. Show me the kitchen.
Ocon, you are head of credit in that company. Tell me what my file says.
Ocon, you are head of credit in that company. Tell me what my file says. It says 60 million naira, Mr. Bakare. The final date is Friday, the 31st of October. After that, they take this house and
October. After that, they take this house and every car in your yard. My husband, tell him about the buyer. Alhaji pays 150 million at the key
Alhaji pays 150 million at the key handover. Saturday, the 25th, 4:00 in my brother's house in Ikoyi. Your brother's will gives that house to the girl the day she puts her degree
Your brother's will gives that house to the girl the day she puts her degree certificate in his barrister's hand. The barrister will ask for the heir's consent.
The barrister will ask for the heir's consent. Then the paper tells him the truth. She signed it in front of me in Abuja
Then the paper tells him the truth. She signed it in front of me in Abuja on the 14th of March. That girl was in Lagos that whole week
That girl was in Lagos that whole week coughing over one of her exams. I signed her name myself and a notary in Abuja stamped it.
I signed her name myself and a notary in Abuja stamped it. And her certificate? Without it, the barrister cannot hand her one brick. And a clerk's wife has no time for lawyers.
And a clerk's wife has no time for lawyers. And my 20? When the keys change hands.
Then on Saturday, we throw a party in that house so all Lagos sees it was to sell.
So this is the girl. Clerk, how much
So this is the girl. Clerk, how much does that company pay you that you bring a wife home with one bag? I will report them to the chairman.
I will report them to the chairman. Good evening, ma. You live in a house like this? I keep madam's books in the evenings. She keeps a roof over me.
I keep madam's books in the evenings. She keeps a roof over me. Ma, I am not his wife. My uncle gave me to him this morning for a debt.
My uncle gave me to him this morning for a debt. Gave you? Like a goat at a naming ceremony? Hear me, my daughter. Nobody is given in this house.
Hear me, my daughter. Nobody is given in this house. You sleep in the blue guest room inside the main house. Clerk sleeps in the boys' quarters. Chuks. Chuks drives for me. He will carry your
Chuks. Chuks drives for me. He will carry your bag upstairs. Ma, I cannot take a room for nothing. He

With my eyes closed, ma. Open them. My pepper is expensive. Boys' quarters, sir. Welcome to my life.
Boys' quarters, sir. Welcome to my life. Now tell your mother why the chairman of
Now tell your mother why the chairman of Ademola Capital came home through my kitchen. Four months ago, my father died and And his chair.
and And his chair. In our books, loan after loan is marked settled, and not one kobo of it ever reached our accounts. Settled by whom? Approved by one man, Okon, our head of
Settled by whom? Approved by one man, Okon, our head of credit. So for six weeks I have sat in his department as a clerk. Yesterday Jide Bakare came to my desk
Yesterday Jide Bakare came to my desk begging for time. Okon's note on his file says to settle by sale of family house, heirs consent attached.
to settle by sale of family house, heirs consent attached.

in the morning. A final year student in Lagos signing in Abuja on a weekday in exam season. Sir, with respect, you told a debtor to bring his niece to your own speech?
Sir, with respect, you told a debtor to bring his niece to your own speech? He chose the place. He wanted her gone before her name was called, and I want to know why.
He wanted her gone before her name was called, and I want to know why. Then tell her who you are tonight. With what? A copy proves nothing. The original sits in Okon's safe.
A copy proves nothing. The original sits in Okon's safe. If he hears the chairman is near that file, the paper burns. Tomorrow she goes back for her things.
Tomorrow she goes back for her things. If she knows, her face will tell them. Then hear my condition. Wear your clerk's shirt until you hold that paper,
Then hear my condition. Wear your clerk's shirt until you hold that paper, not one day longer. And whatever is hers, you give back.
The debt is paid, my dear. Receipts do not come back.
The debt is paid, my dear. Receipts do not come back. Auntie, I came for my books. Only my books. Then pick them from the gutter.

keep his photographs. Mind your own gate. I hid your lecture notes and your papa's

sees you. She is my mother and I am not blind. My cousin paid for my JAMB form with her own exam money. I can carry one box for her.
own exam money. I can carry one box for her. Bimpe, inside now.

Ma, the car is ready. Leave nothing of yours on this road. And tell your clerk something from me. If he brings you back, the debt comes back with you.
If he brings you back, the debt comes back with you.

And you, clerk, sit too. Nobody eats my pepper on his feet. What is it, my daughter? Seven years I cooked in my uncle's

swallow. Monday then. I will write it on Monday.

how you treat a woman who works this hard? She drinks it. That is how I know she is serious. Look at these. 11 loans, all marked
